# Raw inputs are not redistributed

Create this directory (or follow the original paths recorded in `docs/DATA_SOURCES.md`) before rerunning the download/network scripts. Required source families are: Planet arterial surface lines; HOT/OSM roads and facilities; WorldPop 2020; GHS-SMOD 2020; GDL SHDI; hazard footprints; JRC flood; GRIP4; MAP 2020; Weiss & Nelson 2015; CPAS; SDG 9.1.1 RAI; Meta Map With AI; and OSRM. Licences and URLs are recorded in the documentation.
